report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94 ms durations; traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) and metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98 ms on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence, so no bounded root-cause candidate can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency/error SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94 ms is anomalous
Sustained error or latency metrics over a longer window than 60s
Evidence of a specific fault (5xx, timeouts, pool saturation, memory growth) to bound a candidate
